portals.name: Kaohsiung cadastral map service
portals.operator: Kaohsiung City Government Land Administration Bureau
portals.observation: Official description confirms parcel map, parcel-number locating, map click lookup and thematic land-information queries. It mentions Google/Facebook sign-in for saving/shared search URLs; this is not evidence the viewer requires login for basic viewing. A separate direct viewer host was unresponsive, and no full GeoJSON feature endpoint was verified.
